description: This file implements an HTML parser following the HTML5 parsing algorithm, including tokenization, element stack management, and handling of foreign content. It defines the parser structure, parsing modes, and core functions for parsing HTML documents and fragments.

classes.name: parser
classes.description: Main parser struct implementing the HTML5 parsing algorithm, managing tokenization, element stack, insertion modes, and parsing state.

methods.name: top
methods.description: Returns the current top node of the open element stack or the document root if stack is empty.

methods.name: popUntil
methods.description: Pops elements from the stack until an element with a matching tag is found within a specified scope.

methods.name: indexOfElementInScope
methods.description: Returns the index of the highest element in the stack matching given tags within a scope.

methods.name: elementInScope
methods.description: Checks if an element with given tags exists within a scope without modifying the stack.

methods.name: clearStackToContext
methods.description: Pops elements until a scope-defined element is found.

methods.name: parseGenericRawTextElement
methods.description: Enters raw text mode for elements like <script> or <style>.

methods.name: generateImpliedEndTags
methods.description: Pops elements with specific tags to generate implied end tags, optionally excluding certain tags.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a node as a child to the current top node, and pushes it onto the open element stack if it's an element.

methods.name: insertOpenElement
methods.description: Pushes a new element node onto the open element stack.

methods.name: shouldFosterParent
methods.description: Determines if foster parenting rules should be applied for the next node.

methods.name: fosterParent
methods.description: Inserts a node according to foster parenting rules, typically used for misnested table content.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text to the current node, merging with existing text nodes if possible.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Creates and adds a new element node based on the current token.

methods.name: addFormattingElement
methods.description: Adds a formatting element to the active formatting elements list, removing duplicates if necessary.

methods.name: clearActiveFormattingElements
methods.description: Clears the list of active formatting elements up to a scope marker.

methods.name: reconstructActiveFormattingElements
methods.description: Reconstructs active formatting elements from the list to ensure proper nesting.

methods.name: acknowledgeSelfClosingTag
methods.description: Marks the current token as self-closing processed.

methods.name: setOriginalIM
methods.description: Sets the insertion mode to return to after processing raw text elements.

methods.name: resetInsertionMode
methods.description: Resets the insertion mode based on the current stack of open elements and context.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main parsing loop that reads tokens and processes them according to the current insertion mode.

methods.name: parseCurrentToken
methods.description: Processes the current token through the parser's state machine until it is consumed.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Entry point to parse an HTML document from an io.Reader, returning the root node.

methods.name: ParseFragment
methods.description: Parses an HTML fragment in a given context node.

methods.name: ParseWithOptions
methods.description: Parses an HTML document with configurable options.

methods.name: ParseFragmentWithOptions
methods.description: Parses an HTML fragment with options and a context node.
